beats: My son's teacher writes 'l' as a slanted loop. On his screen, it was a bare stick.
He was learning letters he couldn't even recognize in his own notebook.
So lessons now show how each letter looks written by hand, using a font called Playwrite NO.
The TV wall used to show that handwriting once in every forty cards.
Now every card for a young child shows it — one in forty became one in one.
